objects.summary: COIN-M intraday liquidation source gate fails on causal timing/publication semantics before any economic row is parsed. This is a source-gate failure, not an economic rejection; family remains inactive. A separate Binance spot trend+signed-volume reserve is qualified only at metadata level.

Owner explicitly pauses edge experiments and disables continuation to reconsider research method. F1 remains REJECT, COIN-M source gate failed, RSI reading incomplete, and no new preregistration/outcome/PnL occurs.

Owner-authorized idea-building yields EURUSD-RANGE-GRID-001 as design only. Existing volatility engine is identified for reuse but old NASDAQ evaluation has causal-state defects; no FX source qualification, acquisition, reservation or economic result yet.

Research method is split into two public axes: scoped elimination/prior-evidence audit and mechanism qualification. Source/access failure and weak/null outcomes are explicitly not generalized into whole-market no-edge claims. Mechanism route requires named payer, persistence, causal clock, executable fills, rights, costs and tail/inventory risk before testing.

EUR/USD source qualification advances: HistData is retained only as quote proxy; Dukascopy rights and FXCM access remain unresolved. Existing volatility engine is causally repaired/reused with explicit past state and 28 synthetic tests; still zero market archive/return/PnL/look.

Immutable intraday preregistration and manifest are frozen before outcomes for one RSI/ADX grid rule, two diagnostic comparators and six fixed cost paths. HistData plan covers 21 source-local months; no download submitted or price row opened. Harness/source-QA/reservation gates remain open.

Complete EURUSD exploratory harness is frozen before prices with fixed costs/windows/signal/risk/exits/financing. Seventy FX synthetic cases plus 28 causal-state tests pass locally; market source delivery, execution costs/fills and remote CI still gate any look. Status remains ONE_DESIGN_CANDIDATE with zero market outcomes.

cross_object_findings.finding: COIN-M is stopped because causal information timing is unauthenticated, not because an economic experiment failed. This prevents invalid generalization from data quality to market efficiency.
Owner pause interrupts automatic progression from source idea to economic test and shifts work toward scoped elimination plus mechanism qualification before outcomes.
Existing volatility code is repaired for causal state and reused instead of creating a second engine; synthetic correctness is kept separate from economic evidence.
EURUSD preregistration, source plan and harness become increasingly complete before any price access, but all objects correctly remain design/qualification evidence rather than alpha claims.
